info.longBusinessSummary: Enerpac Tool Group Corp. manufactures and sells a range of industrial products and solutions in the United States, Germany, Australia, Canada, China, Saudi Arabia, Brazil, France, the United Kingdom, and internationally. The company designs, manufactures, and distributes branded hydraulic and mechanical tools; and provides services and tool rentals to the general industrial, refining and petrochemical, industrial maintenance, repair and operations, machining and manufacturing, power generation, infrastructure, mining and other markets. It also provides branded tools, cylinders, pumps, hydraulic torque wrenches, highly engineered heavy lifting technology solutions, and other tools; and maintenance and manpower services; high-force hydraulic and mechanical tools, including cylinders, pumps, valves, bolt tensioners, specialty tools and other miscellaneous products. It markets its branded tools and services primarily under ENERPAC, HYDRATIGHT, LARZEP, DTA the Smart Move, and SIMPLEX brand names through network of distributors, direct sales to OEMs, and select end users. The company was formerly known as Actuant Corporation and changed its name to Enerpac Tool Group Corp. in January 2020. Enerpac Tool Group Corp. was incorporated in 1910 and is headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin.
